evidence.detail: Disposable ATTENDED_REVIEW_HUB_CONFIG paths and fixture hubs: hub-config set validates first, writes 0600 atomically, show/clear report; a never-enabled session adopts the machine default when served via Tailscale (harness codex, later plain-shell CLI reused); --no-hub saved disable, --hub saved destination and ATTENDED_REVIEW_HUB each outrank the file; a machine-sourced destination follows file changes; invalid schema/origin, non-JSON and unreadable files publish nothing, keep exit 0 and warn in status without file content; missing file: no files, fields or requests (AC01 differential identical vs RFC_BASE_SHA). Suite 53 OK.
